lead.titleZh: 肩袖撕裂VR训练、卒中皮层激活与肌少症评估：3项高分研究
lead.titleEn: Rotator Cuff VR Training, Stroke Cortical Activation, Sarcopenia Assessment: 3 High-Score Studies
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共有 6 份条目，涵盖 4 个专业方向，其中 3 项研究 curatedScore 达到 75 分，证据等级最高。骨科与肌骨领域的 RCT 探讨了虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练对肩袖撕裂患者的效用；神经康复方向一项观察研究关注卒中后负荷依赖性运动皮层激活的保留情况；老年康复领域则有一项综述针对资源受限环境下肌少症评估提供了专家共识。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's edition features 6 entries across 4 specialties, with 3 studies achieving a curatedScore of 75, indicating the highest evidence level. The top-scoring studies include an RCT in Orthopedics & Musculoskeletal on virtual reality–assisted task-oriented training for rotator cuff tears, an observational study in Neurorehabilitation on preserved load-dependent motor cortical activation post-stroke, and a review in Geriatric Rehabilitation offering expert consensus on sarcopenia assessment in resource-constrained settings.

items.title: Effects of Virtual Reality–Assisted Task-Oriented Training on Clinical and Psychosocial Outcomes in Individuals with Rotator Cuff Tears: A Randomized Controlled Single-Blind Trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled single-blind trial aimed to examine the effects of virtual reality–assisted task-oriented training (VR-TOT) added to conventional physiotherapy in individuals with rotator cuff tears (RCT).
items.curatedReason: 这项初步的随机对照试验表明，在常规物理治疗中加入 VR 辅助任务导向训练，可能对肩袖撕裂患者的临床和心理社会结局有积极影响。你可以考虑将其作为一种新的辅助手段，但仍需等待更大规模、更长期的研究确认其长期疗效。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练对肩袖撕裂患者临床和心理社会结局的影响：一项随机对照单盲试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照单盲试验旨在研究虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练 (VR-TOT) 联合常规物理治疗对肩袖撕裂患者临床和心理社会结局的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary RCT suggests that adding VR-assisted task-oriented training to conventional physical therapy may positively impact clinical and psychosocial outcomes for rotator cuff tear patients. You might consider it as a novel adjunct, but larger, longer-term studies are needed to confirm its long-term efficacy.
items.limitation: 研究样本量、随访时间、以及患者对 VR 技术的适应性可能对结果的外推性造成局限，且是单盲试验。
items.limitationEn: Limitations include sample size, follow-up duration, and patient adaptation to VR technology, which may limit generalizability. It was also a single-blind trial.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Load-dependent Motor Cortical Activation Assessed by fNIRS Is Partially Preserved After Stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 12 stroke patients and 12 healthy controls found that stroke patients preserved proportional load-related hemodynamic responses in the ipsilesional posterior parietal cortex (PPC) during upper limb lifting tasks, suggesting a compensatory role for the PPC, while no such responses were found in primary motor cortical areas.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，卒中患者的后顶叶皮层（PPC）在负荷运动中可能扮演代偿角色，维持着与负荷量成比例的激活，这不同于初级运动皮层。临床上，在制定上肢卒中康复的神经调控策略时，可以考虑将 PPC 作为监测皮层参与和干预的潜在靶点。
items.titleZh: 卒中后负荷依赖性运动皮层激活（fNIRS 评估）部分保留
items.summaryZh: 一项对 12 名卒中患者和 12 名健康对照的横断面研究发现，卒中患者在上肢负荷任务中，病灶侧后顶叶皮层（PPC）的血流动力学反应保留了与负荷成比例的激活，提示 PPC 的代偿作用，而初级运动皮层则没有。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that the posterior parietal cortex (PPC) in stroke patients may play a compensatory role in load-dependent motor tasks, maintaining load-proportional activation distinct from primary motor areas. Clinically, consider the PPC as a potential target for monitoring cortical engagement and for neuromodulation strategies in upper limb stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本横断面设计（12 名卒中患者 vs 12 名健康对照），结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (12 stroke patients vs 12 healthy controls) and a cross-sectional design, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Errorless learning of a video call in Alzheimer Disease: verbal motor error dissociation as a potential marker of procedural learning (a pilot study)
items.summary: This pilot study (N=20) found that people with Alzheimer's Disease (AD) acquired a three-step video call procedure through errorless learning, with mean execution time falling from 41.7 to 23.3 seconds. Verbal errors decreased significantly, while motor errors increased, consistent with a dissociation between procedural performance and explicit verbal report.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，无错学习法可帮助阿尔茨海默病患者习得新的日常沟通任务，并支持保留的程序性记忆在康复中的应用。在患者出现认知衰退时，可以考虑采用这种策略来促进功能独立。
items.titleZh: 阿尔茨海默病患者视频通话的无错学习：言语运动错误分离作为程序性学习的潜在标志（一项初步研究）
items.summaryZh: 这项初步研究（N=20）发现，阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者通过无错学习法习得了三步视频通话流程，平均执行时间从 41.7 秒降至 23.3 秒。言语错误显著减少，而运动错误增加，这与程序性表现和外显言语报告之间的分离一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that errorless learning can help individuals with Alzheimer's disease acquire new daily communication tasks, supporting the use of preserved procedural memory in rehabilitation. You might consider this strategy to promote functional independence in patients experiencing cognitive decline.
items.limitation: 本研究为小型试点研究（20 名患者），样本量小，且结果来自预印本，尚未经过同行评审。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot study (20 patients), with a limited sample size, and the results are from a preprint, not yet peer-reviewed.

items.title: Sarcopenia Assessment in Resource-Constrained Settings: Expert Agreement on Surrogate Measures
items.summary: An expert agreement process identified the 5-times sit-to-stand test (CVI=0.8-1.0), Timed Up and Go (CVI=1.0), and calf circumference (CVI=0.7-1.0) as relevant and appropriate pragmatic proxy measures for sarcopenia assessment in resource-constrained settings, with potential for digital integration. The review was based on 10 studies.
items.curatedReason: 在资源受限的环境中评估肌少症，5 次坐站试验（5STS）、计时起立行走试验（TUG）和小腿围（CC）作为替代指标获得专家高度认可。这些工具可能有助于你在临床实践中进行远程筛查和监测，尤其是针对社区和老年患者。
items.titleZh: 资源受限环境下肌少症评估：专家对替代测量指标的共识
items.summaryZh: 一项专家共识流程确定，5 次坐站试验（CVI=0.8-1.0）、计时起立行走试验（CVI=1.0）和小腿围（CVI=0.7-1.0）是资源受限环境下肌少症评估的相关且合适的实用替代测量指标，具有数字整合潜力。该综述基于 10 项研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: For sarcopenia assessment in resource-constrained settings, the 5-times sit-to-stand test (5STS), Timed Up and Go (TUG), and calf circumference (CC) are highly endorsed by experts as surrogate measures. These tools could help you with remote screening and monitoring in clinical practice, especially for community-dwelling and older patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为专家共识，尚未通过临床研究验证这些替代指标的有效性、可靠性和远程评估的可行性。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on expert agreement, and the validity, reliability, and feasibility of these surrogate measures for remote assessment still require further clinical studies.

items.title: C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio adds independent prognostic value to the clinical frailty scale in older emergency department patients: a multicenter cohort study
items.summary: This multicenter cohort study found that the C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR) adds independent prognostic value to the clinical frailty scale (CFS) in older emergency department patients, suggesting its utility in comprehensive frailty risk assessment.
items.curatedReason: C 反应蛋白/白蛋白比率（CAR）与临床衰弱量表（CFS）结合，能为急诊科老年患者提供独立的预后价值。在老年患者的筛查中，您可以考虑将 CAR 作为一种潜在的补充指标，以更全面地评估衰弱风险。
items.titleZh: C 反应蛋白/白蛋白比率在老年急诊患者临床衰弱量表中的独立预后价值：一项多中心队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心队列研究发现，C 反应蛋白/白蛋白比率（CAR）在老年急诊患者的临床衰弱量表（CFS）中增加了独立的预后价值，提示其在全面衰弱风险评估中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR), combined with the Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS), provides independent prognostic value in older emergency department patients. You might consider CAR as a potential complementary indicator in geriatric screening to comprehensively assess frailty risk.
items.limitation: 这是一项多中心队列研究，但其发现仍需进一步的随机对照试验验证，以明确其在临床干预中的具体指导作用。
items.limitationEn: This is a multicenter cohort study, but its findings require further validation through randomized controlled trials to clarify its specific guidance in clinical interventions.

items.title: Integrating Wearable Sensor Technology into Outpatient Rehabilitation Care: A Proof-of-Concept Study
items.summary: A digital health solution integrating wrist sensor data into EHRs was developed and tested in outpatient rehabilitation. The solution showed feasibility and good usability, with 17 clinicians and 38 patients participating over 9 months, and 90.2% of recent sensor data available in EHRs for clinic visits.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究展示了将可穿戴传感器数据集成到门诊康复电子健康记录中的可行性和可用性。这为你探索远程监控和患者日常活动数据在临床中的应用，提供了早期实证依据。
items.titleZh: 将可穿戴传感器技术整合到门诊康复护理中：一项概念验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项将腕部传感器数据整合到电子健康记录（EHR）的数字健康解决方案在门诊康复中进行了开发和测试。该方案在 9 个月内由 17 名临床医生和 38 名患者参与，显示出可行性和良好的可用性，90.2% 的最新传感器数据可在诊所就诊时通过 EHR 获取。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-concept study demonstrates the feasibility and usability of integrating wearable sensor data into outpatient rehabilitation EHRs. It provides early empirical evidence for you to explore the clinical application of remote monitoring and patient daily activity data.
items.limitation: 这是一项概念验证研究，样本量较小，且仅在一个机构进行，其结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: As a proof-of-concept study, the sample size is small and it was conducted at a single institution, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
